subject: Consolidated gateway SKUs + co-sell routing (proposal & asks)
messages:
From: Anna Liu <anna@aws-partner.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cope@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Lynch <sean.lynch@azurepartner.com>, GCP Marketplace PM <gcp-pm@google.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: unified gateway SKU ask for CloudMarketAlliance pilot

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. CloudMarketAlliance is launching a pilot to surface inference runtimes across AWS/Azure/GCP and they want a small, clear set of SKUs per cloud so partners can show up in co-sell opportunities without heavy catalog fragmentation. High level ask from their side:

- A minimal entry SKU (self-serve) for each cloud region with predictable pricing and a 24/7 co-sell badge.
- A mid-tier (dedicated) SKU for customers that need predictable throughput and data isolation.
- A marketplace-only bundle that includes observability add-ons for enterprise trials.

Can you share the SKU split you're considering and any recommended regional gating? They want something that can be listed in the EU marketplaces by end of March for a pilot cohort.

Attaching the Alliance pilot brief (see stub) and a template for SKU metadata.

Thanks,
Anna
Partner Lead, Cloud Partnerships
AWS Partner Network

Attachments: CMA_pilot_brief.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Liu <anna@aws-partner.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: unified gateway SKU ask for CloudMarketAlliance pilot

Thanks Anna — appreciate the context. High level response from Redwood below; we'll iterate this into a formal spreadsheet. Quick notes:

- Entry SKU (Marketplace-Entry): single-model hosted endpoint, token-based pricing, enables streaming, no dedicated GPUs. Target regions: EU-WEST-1, EU-CENTRAL-1, US-EAST-1 for pilot.
- Dedicated SKU (Marketplace-Reserved): reserved capacity on dedicated pools, SLA-backed, separate billing; gated to customers with a minimum commit.
- Bundle SKU (Marketplace-Pro): combines Dedicated + 90-day observability retention + onboarding credits. Marketplace listing will include explicit routing policy so requests can fall back to hosted variant.

Questions for the Alliance: does co-sell require identical SKU names across clouds or just functional parity? If they need identical SKUs (same slug), we should push back on regional differences for legal/pricing reasons.

Sharing an internal draft (redwood_gateway_sku_split_v1.xlsx) — it's a first pass with suggested region mapping. Karthik / Soojin — can you review the suggested EU gating and pricing bands? I also want a short co-sell routing diagram (who we want on the GTM ask list).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_gateway_sku_split_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Intro: unified gateway SKU ask for CloudMarketAlliance pilot

Marissa — quick scan and my POV from product/regional compliance:

- EU gating: EU-WEST-1 and EU-CENTRAL-1 should be a must for pilot. Some customers in DACH require on-prem or VPC-only options — flag them as "enterprise-only" (not a marketplace listing).
- SKU naming: recommend functional parity but distinct slugs per cloud (e.g., rw-marketplace-entry-aws, rw-marketplace-entry-azure, rw-marketplace-entry-gcp) to simplify billing and legal.
- Pricing bands: Entry = usage-based (per token), Mid = monthly reserved + token overage, Bundle = annual contract.

I added a short note to the spreadsheet about data residency clauses and a suggested fallback policy for latency-sensitive routes (fallback to regional hosted variant rather than cross-cloud).

— Soojin
Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Anna Liu <anna@aws-partner.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Sean Lynch <sean.lynch@azurepartner.com>, GCP Marketplace PM <gcp-pm@google.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: unified gateway SKU ask for CloudMarketAlliance pilot

Anna / team — thanks, good thread. A few practical asks from GTM/field enablement to make co-sell clean:

1) Co-sell trigger metadata: for each SKU we need a short field set that the partners can use to qualify (minimum ARR, expected latency, allowed regions, support SLA). I'll add that to the spreadsheet.

2) Marketplace listing IDs: if the Alliance expects a single GTM narrative, we should prepare a one-page "co-sell play" per cloud that includes the routing fallback and recommended sales pitch (one-sheeter for partner reps).

3) Integration points: for Azure and GCP, there are slightly different procurement flows — Sean / GCP PM, please confirm the required Go-To-Market attachments (e.g., co-marketing assets, trial credits flow).

Next steps: I'll attach a routing diagram (co-sell-routing-diagram.png) and a checklist for cloud onboarding. Marissa — can you consolidate the one-pagers and confirm if we want identical SKUs or slugs per Soojin's recommendation?

Onwards,
Jonas Weber
Director, Field GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments: co-sell-routing-diagram.png (image), cloud-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Liu <anna@aws-partner.com>, Sean Lynch <sean.lynch@azurepartner.com>, GCP Marketplace PM <gcp-pm@google.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Consolidated gateway SKUs + co-sell routing (proposal & asks)

Team / partners —

Attached is our consolidated proposal for the CloudMarketAlliance pilot. Key decisions we are proposing:

- Use distinct SKU slugs per cloud for legal/billing simplicity, but keep functional parity across clouds.
- Pilot EU regions: EU-WEST-1 (AWS), West Europe (Azure), and europe-west1 (GCP). Those will be the primary listed regions for the entry SKU.
- Dedicated SKU will be a marketplace-eligible offer but gated behind a direct sales motion and a minimum commit.
- Bundle SKU (Marketplace-Pro) will be listed with an explicit co-sell badge and include 90-day observability retention.

Can partners confirm: 1) acceptance of cloud-specific slugs, 2) any blocked regions for listing in the EU, and 3) timeline to publish listings (we are aiming for March 29 pilot go-live).

Next steps from our side: final spreadsheet updated (redwood_gateway_sku_split_v1.xlsx), routing diagram, and play one-pagers in the Drive link. If no objections by EOD Friday (20 Feb), we will submit listings to each marketplace.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_gateway_sku_split_v1.xlsx (updated), co-sell-routing-diagram.png, cloud-onboarding-checklist.pdf
